_comment: Stratified random sample of AAK-MCP-001 hits for blind human adjudication. Selection: within each stratum, the n_h hits with the lowest SHA-256(seed + ':' + hit_id). Re-derive with sample.py from the frame below. hit_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256(config content key + NUL + server name).

strata.rule: host is loopback or a private-network name or address
host is a template variable, a placeholder name, or unparseable
the URL carries a credential (literal or placeholder), or the config carries an auth-looking header the rule does not recognize
public https; the unauthenticated initialize got HTTP 401 or 403
public https; the unauthenticated initialize got a JSON-RPC result
public https; any other answer, no answer, or not probed
